style: Cinematic hand-painted 2D animation for an adult historical drama, 16:9 landscape. Set in a fictional depiction of ancient Pethor near the Euphrates. A working river settlement with low mudbrick houses, reed mats, timber landing posts, rough woven cloth, clay jars, grain sacks and a low wooden rope ferry. Buildings and clothing show ordinary wear from work and weather. Expressive, anatomically grounded character designs. Restrained facial acting, readable silhouettes and deliberate movement. Painted backgrounds with visible texture, layered depth and natural atmospheric perspective. Warm ochre earth, faded indigo cloth and olive-gray daylight. Night scenes use blue-gray river water, soft moonlight and small amber oil lamps. Light comes from sources visible or implied in the scene.
direction: Frame conversations at human eye level. Give characters time to listen before they react. In suspense scenes, let the camera hold while the environment changes inside the frame. Floodwater has weight, an irregular surface and visible debris carried by the current. Keep the supernatural encounters visually ordinary. Balaam hears a voice in the same physical world as the wind, reeds and river.
